grammar.purpose: Say how old someone is
grammar.explanation: Age needs no verb: 我二十五岁 ("I twenty-five years"). 今年 (this year) often comes first. Ask a peer 你多大？, a child 你几岁？, and an elder 您多大年纪了？.

grammar.pattern: X 月 X 号 + 星期 X
grammar.purpose: Give a date and a day of the week
grammar.explanation: Chinese goes from big to small: month, then day, then weekday. Days are numbers too: 星期一 is Monday, 星期六 Saturday; Sunday is 星期天. Ask with 几: 几月几号？ 星期几？

grammar.purpose: Say what you can do
grammar.explanation: 会 is a skill you have learned: 会说中文, 会写汉字. 能 is being able or free to do something right now: 我能教你, 明天我不能去. The negatives are 不会 and 不能.

examples.en: I can't write characters.

examples.en: I can't go tomorrow.

commonMistakes.why: Speaking a language is a learned skill, so 会 is the usual choice.

grammar.pattern: verb + 一点儿 · 有点儿 + adjective
grammar.purpose: Say "a little" the right way
grammar.explanation: 一点儿 is an amount, after a verb or adjective: 说一点儿中文, 慢一点儿. 有点儿 goes before an adjective and usually sounds like a mild complaint: 汉字有点儿难.

examples.en: I speak a little Chinese.

examples.py: Hànzì yǒudiǎnr nán.
examples.en: Characters are a bit hard.

examples.py: Màn yìdiǎnr, hǎo ma?
examples.en: A bit slower, please?

commonMistakes.why: Before an adjective, use 有点儿.

grammar.pattern: 太 + adjective + 了 · 很 / 非常 + adjective
grammar.purpose: Describe how hot, cold or nice it is
grammar.explanation: Adjectives work as verbs, so no 是: 今天很冷. Bare 很 is mild; 非常 is "very"; 太…了 is "so…!" or "too…", a reaction. Don't drop 了 from 太…了 in speech.

grammar.purpose: Ask how something is, or what someone thinks
grammar.explanation: Put 怎么样 at the end to ask about a state or an opinion: 天气怎么样？ (What's the weather like?) 这个蛋糕怎么样？ (How's the cake?) After a suggestion it means "how about it?".

grammar.pattern: 我 / 你 / 您 / 他 / 她 · 我们 / 你们 / 他们 / 她们

grammar.explanation: Use 我 for the speaker, 你 for the listener and 您 for respectful singular address. 他 and 她 sound identical: tā. 我们 includes the speaker; 你们 addresses a group. 他们 can refer to men or a mixed group; 她们 is written for a female group. Do not add 们 to 您 in beginner usage.

grammar.pattern: 想 + verb · 要 + verb / noun
grammar.purpose: Distinguish a wish from a decision
grammar.explanation: 想 + verb expresses a wish or inclination: 想去. 要 + verb often expresses a decision, intention or need. 要 + noun orders or requests something: 我要米饭. Context matters; 要 does not always mean an obligation. Negate a wish with 不想. 不要 can sound like a refusal or prohibition. Soften invitations with 吗 or 吧.

grammar.purpose: Add a shared interest or another activity
grammar.explanation: 也 adds a matching fact about another person or activity: 我也想去. 还 adds something further or indicates continuation: 还要吃饭 / 还在看. Both come before the predicate, after the subject. 还有 introduces another item that is available. Do not put 也 at the end as if it were English “too”.

grammar.pattern: 多大 / 多少 / 几 / 哪 / 哪里 / 哪儿 / 哪些 / 什么 / 谁 / 怎么
grammar.purpose: Choose the information you need
grammar.explanation: 多 + adjective asks degree: 多大 asks age or size. 多少 asks amount; 几 asks a number expected to be small and takes a classifier before a noun. 哪 chooses one; 哪些 chooses several. 哪里 and 哪儿 ask place. 什么 asks a thing, 谁 a person, 怎么 a method. Put the question word in the answer’s position.

grammar.purpose: Ask a follow-up question without an extra question particle
grammar.explanation: Keep ordinary Chinese word order when using a question word: 你去学校 becomes 你去哪里. The question word itself asks for information, so do not add 吗. 谁 can be the subject or object. Several short follow-ups are easier to answer than one long interrogation. Use 请问 with an unfamiliar person.

grammar.pattern: 这 / 那 · 这儿 / 那儿 · 这里 / 那里 · 这些 / 那些 · 别的 / 有的
grammar.purpose: Point to a thing, place or subset
grammar.explanation: 这 and 那 distinguish this from that; add classifier + noun: 这本书. 这儿 / 这里 and 那儿 / 那里 name places. 这些 / 那些 refer to plural sets without an extra 们. 有的 picks some members of a known set; 别的 means other or different ones. Establish the set before saying 有的 so the reference is clear.

commonMistakes.why: 这些 already refers to a plural set; do not add 们.

grammar.pattern: noun / pronoun + 的 · adjective · number + classifier + noun
grammar.purpose: Describe which object you mean
grammar.explanation: Place descriptions before the noun: 我的书, 新书, 两本书. A possessor or longer adjective phrase often uses 的: 我的书, 很新的书. A simple adjective may attach directly, as in 新书. A quantity needs a classifier: 一本书, 一个杯子. Do not confuse 本 (classifier) with 本子 (notebook) or 杯 (cupful) with 杯子 (container).

grammar.pattern: numbers · 二 / 两 · 十 / 百 · 半
grammar.purpose: Count portions and prices
grammar.explanation: 零、一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九 name digits. 十 starts the tens: 十一, 二十; 百 starts hundreds: 一百. Use 二 in 二十 and room numbers; use 两 before ordinary classifiers: 两个鸡蛋. 半 means half: 半杯奶. Read 元 as formal yuan, 块 as everyday yuan, and 毛 as one tenth of a yuan. Citation pinyin keeps 一 as yī; its spoken tone changes before following tones.

commonMistakes.why: Use 二 rather than 两 in 二十.

grammar.purpose: Measure what each person gets
grammar.explanation: A quantity phrase combines a number with a classifier, usually followed by the noun: 三个鸡蛋, 两杯水. When the object is already understood, the noun can be omitted: 我要两个. 半 precedes the classifier. Some amounts name a portion rather than an object: 半杯奶 is a measured amount of milk.

grammar.pattern: 杯 / 本 / 个 / 家 / 间 / 口 / 块 / 页
grammar.purpose: Choose what a number counts
grammar.explanation: Use 杯 for cupfuls, 本 for books, 个 for many ordinary objects, 家 for shops/businesses, 间 for rooms, 口 in family-member counts, 块 for yuan or pieces, and 页 for pages. 一杯水 counts the drink; 一个杯子 counts its container. Classifiers are linked to a noun, not chosen by English plural endings.

grammar.pattern: person + 有 + object · place + 有 + object
grammar.purpose: Describe possession and existence
grammar.explanation: 有 means have with a person as subject, and there is/are with a place as subject. A place may include 里/上: 包里有一本书. Negate with 没有, not 不有. For an unknown object in a place, introduce it after 有; to locate a known object, use 在: 我的书在桌子上.

grammar.pattern: description + 的 + noun · manner + 地 + verb
grammar.purpose: Distinguish ownership from manner
grammar.explanation: 的 links a description to a noun: 我的包, 认真的学生. 地 links a manner description to a verb: 认真地读. Both are neutral-tone de, but their written forms and functions differ. In natural speech simple manner words may occur without 地; do not treat every omission as wrong. 我的 can stand alone when the possessed noun is understood.

examples.en: This is my textbook; that one belongs to someone else.

examples.en: Read carefully.

commonMistakes.why: The noun 课本 needs an ownership phrase with 的, not an adverbial phrase with 地.

grammar.purpose: Say what an action affects
grammar.explanation: Put an ordinary object after the verb: 找钱包, 帮我, 读今天的课文. A noun phrase can contain ownership or a description. Do not confuse the object with the subject: 我找你的书 says who searches and what they search for. Chinese can omit an already understood object in conversation; an omitted object is not automatically an error.

grammar.pattern: 马上 / 先 / 有时 · 在 / 正 / 正在
grammar.purpose: Place timing words before the action
grammar.explanation: 马上 says right away; 先 marks what happens first; 有时/有时候 means sometimes. Put these before the main verb, after the subject. 在/正/正在 can mark an ongoing action. Compare 我在家 (location) with 我在读书 (ongoing action). The two meanings of 在 have different complements.

grammar.pattern: 在 / 正在 + verb · 在 / 正 / 正在 + verb + 呢 · action + 呢
grammar.purpose: Report an action in progress
grammar.explanation: Use 在 or 正在 before an action verb to emphasize that it is happening now. 呢 may close the sentence; with clear context it can carry the ongoing meaning without 在: 我读书呢. 正 commonly pairs with 呢. These patterns do not make all verbs progressive: states such as 有 normally do not use 正在. A question can ask 你在干什么？

grammar.pattern: 常 / 常常 + action · 先…再…
grammar.purpose: Describe habits and order later actions
grammar.explanation: 常 and 常常 say that an action happens often. They go before the verb, after a stated subject: 我常在家学习. They are not exact frequency percentages. 再 marks a further or later action, often in 先…再…. Here 再 looks forward; 昨天又读了一遍 uses 又 for an already repeated action, not yesterday’s 再.

examples.zh: 我常在家读书，她常常上午学习。

examples.en: I often read at home; she often studies in the morning.

examples.py: xiān chī wǎn fàn , zài qù shàng kè .
examples.en: Eat dinner first, then go to class.

commonMistakes.why: 常 is placed before the verb phrase, not between verb and object.

grammar.purpose: Place the circumstances before the action
grammar.explanation: Time expressions can precede the subject or follow it: 晚上我学习 / 我晚上学习. Place phrases such as 在家 normally precede the action. Adverbs such as 常常 and manner descriptions such as 认真地 also precede the action. A simple adjective can modify an action without 地: 慢一点读. Do not move an ordinary object into the place of a time phrase.

grammar.pattern: 不 / 没 / 没有 · 别 + verb
grammar.purpose: Negate a habit, a past event or an instruction
grammar.explanation: 不 commonly negates a habit, intention or state: 我不喝奶; 房间不大. 没/没有 negates an event that did not happen: 昨天没上课. 没有 also means not have: 没有课. Do not use 不有. 别 gives a negative instruction: 别忘了. The choice is about meaning, not a rule that every past sentence contains 没.

examples.en: I do not drink milk and did not drink it yesterday either.

examples.zh: 星期日没有课，别去学校。

examples.en: There is no class on Sunday; do not go to school.

examples.en: This room is not large.

commonMistakes.why: 有 is negated with 没有, not 不有.

grammar.pattern: verb + 不 + verb · 有 + 没有
grammar.purpose: Ask an A-not-A question
grammar.explanation: Repeat the verb around its negative: 去不去, 是不是; 有 uses 有没有. Two-syllable verbs can repeat fully or shorten the first part: 喜欢不喜欢 / 喜不喜欢. These questions already ask for a yes/no choice, so do not add 吗 in the same neutral question. Answer with the affirmative or negative verb; 是 is not a universal English-style yes.

grammar.purpose: Give the location of an action
grammar.explanation: 在 introduces where an action happens: 我在车站等你. The place phrase normally comes before the action verb. Compare 我在车站, where 在 itself states location, with 我在等你, where 在 marks an ongoing action. The following word tells you which use is intended.

examples.py: wǒ zài chē zhàn páng biān děng nǐ .
examples.en: I will wait beside the station.

examples.py: wǒ men zài zhè biān mǎi chē piào .
examples.en: We buy tickets on this side.

commonMistakes.why: Put the location before 等 and its object 你.

grammar.purpose: Build an ordinary verb-predicate sentence
grammar.explanation: An ordinary action sentence has a subject and a verb phrase: 我买车票. Time and place can precede the verb: 我八点在车站买票. A yes/no question may use 吗; the action does not need 是. This family concerns action predicates; adjective and nominal predicates have their own patterns.

examples.py: wǒ mǎi chē piào , nǐ děng péng you .
examples.en: I buy tickets; you wait for our friend.

examples.py: péng you zài dà xué zhàn xià chē .
examples.en: Our friend gets off at University Station.

commonMistakes.why: For a neutral statement of the action, do not insert 是 before 买. Contextual emphatic 是 has a different use.

grammar.purpose: Read a complete appointment date and time
grammar.explanation: Write a date from larger units to smaller: 二零二六年十月六日. 年 is read digit by digit; 〇 in a year is líng. 日 is formal; 号 is common in speech. A weekday uses 星期 plus 一 to 六, or 日/天 for Sunday. Clock time puts 点 before minutes: 八点零五分. 半 means half past, so 八点半 is eight thirty. Use 二 in 二零二六年 but 两 in 两点.

examples.zh: 二零二六年十月六日，星期二。

grammar.purpose: Say who accompanies an action
grammar.explanation: As prepositions, 跟 and 和 introduce a companion before the main verb: 我跟朋友去北京. The subject performs the action with that person. 跟 can also mean follow as a verb, but that is not its companion use here. Keep the companion before the main verb phrase.

examples.py: wǒ gēn péng you qù běi jīng .
examples.en: I am going to Beijing with a friend.

examples.py: nǎi nai hé yé ye yì qǐ hē chá .
examples.en: Grandmother drinks tea with grandfather.

commonMistakes.why: In this companion construction, place 跟朋友 before 去北京.

grammar.pattern: A 和 / 跟 B · A 还是 B?
grammar.purpose: Join people or ask a choice
grammar.explanation: 和 and colloquial 跟 can join coordinated nouns: 我跟朋友都来; both people are subjects. Compare 我跟朋友去 with 我跟朋友都去; 都 makes the shared subject reading clear. Use 还是 between alternatives in a question: 去北京还是在家? 和 is not the ordinary connector for two complete sentences. A 还是 question asks a choice and does not require 吗.

examples.py: yé ye hé nǎi nai dōu lái .
examples.en: Grandfather and grandmother are both coming.

examples.py: wǒ gēn péng you dōu xǐ huān hē chá .

grammar.pattern: 很 / 非常 / 太 / 真 / 最 + adjective
grammar.purpose: Choose the strength of a description
grammar.explanation: 很 often makes a neutral adjective predicate natural and need not mean an unusually high degree. 非常 is stronger. 真 gives a sincere reaction. 太…了 can praise or complain according to the adjective and context: 太好看了 / 太贵了. 最 selects the highest degree within an understood set; make the comparison set clear.

examples.zh: 这件衣服很好看，那件非常好看。
examples.py: zhè jiàn yī fú hěn hǎo kàn , nà jiàn fēi cháng hǎo kàn .
examples.en: This item looks good; that one looks very good.

examples.zh: 这个颜色真好看，太好看了！
examples.py: zhè gè yán sè zhēn hǎo kàn , tài hǎo kàn le !
examples.en: This colour looks really good—so good!

examples.py: zhè sān jiàn , bái sè de zuì hǎo kàn .
examples.en: Of these three, the white one looks best.

commonMistakes.right: 这三件衣服，白色的最好看。
commonMistakes.why: Use 最 without 很 before the same adjective, and state the comparison set.

grammar.purpose: Describe an attribute directly
grammar.explanation: An adjective can be the predicate: 包很重; 衣服很好看. Do not routinely put 是 before it. In a neutral positive sentence 很 is often useful without strong “very”; a contrast can omit it, as 白色好看，黑色不好看. Negative adjectives use 不: 不重. A context-sensitive adjective needs an appropriate subject.

examples.py: zhè gè bāo hěn zhòng , nà gè bù zhòng .
examples.en: This bag is heavy; that one is not.

examples.py: yī fú hái méi gān , xiàn zài bù lěng .
examples.en: The clothes are not dry yet; it is not cold now.

commonMistakes.why: Do not add 是 to this neutral adjective predicate.

grammar.purpose: React with a real exclamation
grammar.explanation: A positive reaction can use 太好看了！ or 真好看！; a complaint can use 太晚了！. The delivery and context carry the emotion. Exclamation marks do not change an ordinary statement into a question. A plain compliment is also valid; choose the intensity to suit the relationship.

examples.py: zhēn hǎo kàn !
examples.en: That really looks good!

examples.py: tài wǎn le ! míng tiān zài kàn ba .
examples.en: It is too late! Let us look again tomorrow.

commonMistakes.why: Use a statement exclamation for praise, not 吗 unless you mean a question.

grammar.purpose: Name the comparison reference
grammar.explanation: 比 introduces the reference B: 图书馆比商场安静 compares the library with the shopping centre. Keep the adjective after both A and B. Do not add 很 before that adjective in this simple comparison. State the same attribute for both things; 比 does not mean every attribute is better.

examples.py: tú shū guǎn bǐ shāng chǎng ān jìng .
examples.en: The library is quieter than the shopping centre.

examples.py: zuò chē bǐ zǒu lù kuài .
examples.en: Taking a vehicle is faster than walking.

commonMistakes.why: Do not insert 很 in this basic 比 comparison.

grammar.pattern: A 比 B + adjective · A 没有 B + adjective
grammar.purpose: Keep the direction of a comparison clear
grammar.explanation: A 比 B 快 means A is faster than B. A 没有 B 快 means A is not as fast as B. It does not mean A lacks B. This negative comparison differs from A不比B快, which need not assert that A is slower; here practise 没有. Compare objects on a relevant shared attribute.

examples.py: zǒu lù méi yǒu zuò chē kuài .

grammar.pattern: all + 都 · 一起 / 一块儿 + action
grammar.purpose: Coordinate the whole group
grammar.explanation: 都 refers to every member of a stated group and normally precedes the verb: 我们都去. 一起 and colloquial 一块儿 say people act together; they do not by themselves say that every possible person comes. Compare 我们都回家 with 我们一起回家: everyone goes home versus going home together.

examples.zh: 我们都想走，有些朋友想跑。
examples.py: wǒ men dōu xiǎng zǒu , yǒu xiē péng you xiǎng pǎo .
examples.en: We all want to walk; some friends want to run.

examples.zh: 我们一起走，也一块儿聊天。
examples.py: wǒ men yì qǐ zǒu , yě yī kuàir liáo tiān .
examples.en: We walk together and chat together.

commonMistakes.why: Place 都 before the verb it modifies.

grammar.purpose: Connect compatible actions
grammar.explanation: Related clauses can be placed together without a connector: 我开门，你出来. 一边…一边… coordinates simultaneous activities by the same actor, such as walking and chatting. It does not mean “first…then”. 也 adds a parallel action or fact: 我想走，也想聊天. Choose activities that can actually happen together and keep street safety in mind.

examples.en: I will open the door; you come out.

grammar.pattern: 吧 / 了 / 吗 / 呢
grammar.purpose: Hear what a sentence-ending particle does
grammar.explanation: 吧 can suggest a plan or make a tentative assumption. Sentence-final 了 marks a changed situation: 我知道了. 吗 makes a neutral yes/no question from a statement. 呢 can ask “what about…?” or close an ongoing-action statement. They are not interchangeable endings. A word question such as 几点考试 already asks for missing information and does not add 吗.

examples.py: míng tiān zài kàn ba .
examples.en: Let us look again tomorrow.

examples.py: wǒ zhī dào le .
examples.en: I know now; understood.

examples.py: nǐ míng tiān huí jiā ma ?
examples.en: Are you going home tomorrow?

examples.py: wǒ zài jiā , nǐ ne ?
examples.en: I am at home; what about you?

examples.py: wǒ dú shū ne .
examples.en: I am reading.

commonMistakes.why: Do not add 吗 to the question word 几点 in this direct question.

grammar.pattern: 吗? · question word? · A 还是 B? · A-not-A?
grammar.purpose: Choose the information you need
grammar.explanation: A yes/no question checks a proposition: 明天考试吗？ A question-word question asks a missing detail: 几点考试？ A choice question offers alternatives: 上午还是下午？ An A-not-A question checks a choice of positive/negative: 考不考？ These are different ways to ask, not four endings to combine. A choice needs an actual offered answer; do not answer a time question only with 是.

examples.py: míng tiān kǎo shì ma ?
examples.en: Is the exam tomorrow?

examples.py: jǐ diǎn kǎo shì ?
examples.en: What time is the exam?

examples.py: shàng wǔ hái shi xià wǔ kǎo shì ?
examples.en: Is the exam in the morning or afternoon?

examples.py: míng tiān kǎo bù kǎo ?
examples.en: Is there a test tomorrow or not?

commonMistakes.why: Do not combine the direct 还是 alternatives with 吗 here.

grammar.purpose: Check a proposition politely
grammar.explanation: Add 吗 to an ordinary statement to ask whether it is true: 你买票了 → 你买票了吗？ Answer the specific predicate or give a short fact. This is a neutral question; 不 forms a negative proposition, so 你不回家吗？ may sound surprised in context. Do not mechanically add 吗 to question-word, choice or A-not-A questions.

examples.py: nǐ mǎi jī piào le ma ?
examples.en: Have you bought a plane ticket?

examples.py: nǐ zài wǎng shàng mǎi de ma ?
examples.en: Did you buy it online?

commonMistakes.why: Use one direct yes/no question structure, not two combined.

grammar.pattern: above / below · inside / outside · front / back · left / right · east / south / west / north
grammar.purpose: Locate an object using a clear reference
grammar.explanation: The twelve direction words are 上、下、里、外、前、后、左、右、东、南、西、北. Their side forms are 上边、下边、里边、外边、前边、后边、左边、右边、东边、南边、西边、北边. Say what they are relative to: 楼的东边, 门外. Left/right depend on the person’s orientation; east/west do not. This unit’s map explicitly puts north at the top; do not assume every map does.

examples.en: Inside and outside the gate; upstairs and downstairs.

examples.zh: 楼前、楼后，门左边、门右边。

examples.zh: 上边、下边、里边、外边、前边、后边。
examples.py: shàng biān , xià biān , lǐ bian , wài biān , qián biān , hòu biān .
examples.en: Above, below, inside, outside, in front, behind.

examples.zh: 左边、右边、东边、南边、西边、北边。

examples.zh: 面向北，右边是东，左边是西。
examples.py: miàn xiàng běi , yòu biān shì dōng , zuǒ biān shì xī .
examples.en: Facing north, east is on the right and west on the left.

commonMistakes.why: Right is east only in this stated orientation.

grammar.purpose: Understand an utterance without an expressed subject and predicate
grammar.explanation: A context can support a short non-subject-predicate utterance: 在北门外 answers 在哪儿？; 两个人 answers 几个人？; 好！ accepts a suggestion. Signs can simply say 入口 or 出口. These are complete communicative utterances in context, not a reason to omit necessary information in every sentence. Use a full statement if the reference could be ambiguous.

dialogue.title: Which entrance?

dialogue.purpose: Find the meeting gate and the orientation used for directions.

lines.zh: 我到学校南边了，你们在哪儿？
lines.py: wǒ dào xué xiào nán biān le , nǐ men zài nǎr ?
lines.en: I have reached the south side of the school. Where are you?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 在北门外。北边有车站，南边有商店。
lines.py: zài běi mén wài . běi biān yǒu chē zhàn , nán biān yǒu shāng diàn .
lines.en: Outside the north gate. There is a station to the north and a shop to the south.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我看地图，上边是北，下边是南，对吗？
lines.py: wǒ kàn dì tú , shàng biān shì běi , xià biān shì nán , duì ma ?
lines.en: On the map, the top is north and the bottom is south, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，这张地图上边有一个北字。东在右，西在左。
lines.py: duì , zhè zhāng dì tú shàng biān yǒu yī gè běi zì . dōng zài yòu , xī zài zuǒ .
lines.en: Yes, this map has a north character at the top. East is right, west is left.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 楼的东边有两个入口，我走哪个？
lines.py: lóu de dōng biān yǒu liǎng gè rù kǒu , wǒ zǒu nǎ gè ?
lines.en: There are two entrances on the east side of the building. Which do I take?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先到北门。我们不在东边的入口，也不在西边的书店。
lines.py: xiān dào běi mén . wǒ men bù zài dōng biān de rù kǒu , yě bù zài xī biān de shū diàn .
lines.en: Come to the north gate first. We are not at the eastern entrance or the western bookshop.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我现在面向北，左边是西，右边是东。
lines.py: wǒ xiàn zài miàn xiàng běi , zuǒ biān shì xī , yòu biān shì dōng .
lines.en: I am facing north now: west is on the left, east on the right.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。前边是北，后边是南。你先看前，再看后。
lines.py: duì . qián biān shì běi , hòu biān shì nán . nǐ xiān kàn qián , zài kàn hòu .
lines.en: Correct. Ahead is north, behind is south. Look ahead first, then behind.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 北门前边有两个人，是你们吗？
lines.py: běi mén qián biān yǒu liǎng gè rén , shì nǐ men ma ?
lines.en: There are two people in front of the north gate. Is that you?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是，我们在门前等你。停车场在楼后边。
lines.py: shì , wǒ men zài mén qián děng nǐ . tíng chē chǎng zài lóu hòu biān .
lines.en: Yes, we are waiting in front of the gate. The car park is behind the building.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我在两个入口中间，现在看到你们了。
lines.py: wǒ zài liǎng gè rù kǒu zhōng jiān , xiàn zài kàn dào nǐ men le .
lines.en: I am between the two entrances. I can see you now.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好！看箭头，入口指左，出口指右。我们从入口进去。
lines.py: hǎo ! kàn jiàn tóu , rù kǒu zhǐ zuǒ , chū kǒu zhǐ yòu . wǒ men cóng rù kǒu jìn qù .
lines.en: Good! Look at the arrows: entrance points left, exit points right. We will go in through the entrance.
lines.speaker: b

grammar.purpose: Say what someone does or what something is like
grammar.explanation: A predicate can be a verb or verb phrase: 朋友们进来; 我学习汉语. It can also be an adjective phrase: 邻居很热情; 杯子坏了. Match the subject to the action or property. 是 is not required before an ordinary adjective predicate. A word’s category is not a command to use it in every possible predicate position.

commonMistakes.why: A neutral adjective description does not need 是.

grammar.purpose: Report a fact without turning it into a question
grammar.explanation: A statement gives information: 我住在这里; 我不是工人. It normally ends with a full stop, not a question particle 吗. Use 不 for present negation of 是 or a general habit, and 没 for an action that did not happen. A statement can include 了 or an appropriate adverb. Do not infer that someone completed a course merely because they say 我学习汉语.

commonMistakes.why: Remove 吗 when stating where you live.

grammar.pattern: identity / category · defining characteristic · presence at a place
grammar.purpose: Use 是 with the intended relation
grammar.explanation: Identity/category: 我的邻居是工人. A characteristic can use a noun phrase: 她是一个热情的人; this differs from the direct adjective predicate 她很热情. A place + 是 + noun phrase describes what occupies it: 门外是一棵树; 前边是学校. Compare 门外有一棵树, which introduces something present. These location descriptions require a clear scene, not a blanket substitution of 是 for every 有.

grammar.pattern: 大家 / 别人 / 自己 · 它 / 它们 · 咱 / 咱们
grammar.purpose: Refer to the right people or things
grammar.explanation: 大家 refers to everyone in the relevant group; 别人 means other people. 自己 refers back to the relevant person: 我自己 / 他自己; do not assume its referent without context. 它/它们 normally refer to things or animals in writing. 咱们 explicitly includes the listener; 我们 may include or exclude them. 咱 is northern and informal, and can represent I or we according to context; 咱们 is clearer for inclusive we.

examples.zh: 大家先介绍自己，再听别人介绍。
examples.py: dà jiā xiān jiè shào zì jǐ , zài tīng bié ren jiè shào .
examples.en: Everyone introduces themselves first, then listens to others.

examples.zh: 两本书在桌上，它们是我的。
examples.py: liǎng běn shū zài zhuō shàng , tā men shì wǒ de .
examples.en: The two books are on the table; they are mine.

examples.zh: 咱一起读吧。咱们都参加，你也来。
examples.py: zán yì qǐ dú ba . zán men dōu cān jiā , nǐ yě lái .
examples.en: Let us read together. All of us, including you, will participate.

commonMistakes.right: 我介绍我自己，大家介绍自己。
commonMistakes.why: Keep 自己 attached to the intended person; 大家自己 does not mean just me.

grammar.purpose: Recognize five ways words form a phrase
grammar.explanation: A phrase need not be a full sentence. Coordination joins equals: 读书和聊天. Modification describes a head: 年轻的老师 / 很热情. Verb-object pairs an action and its object: 参加活动. Verb-complement adds a result or direction to an action: 读懂 / 走出来. Subject-predicate pairs a topic with what is said about it: 大家热情. These structural labels do not replace meaning or license arbitrary combinations; 读懂 is a recognition example here and gets fuller result-complement practice later.

examples.zh: 读书和聊天，是今天的活动。
examples.py: dú shū hé liáo tiān , shì jīn tiān de huó dòng .
examples.en: Reading and chatting are today’s activity.

examples.zh: 年轻的老师很热情，大家参加活动。
examples.py: nián qīng de lǎo shī hěn rè qíng , dà jiā cān jiā huó dòng .
examples.en: The young teacher is welcoming; everyone joins the activity.

examples.zh: 这篇文章，我读懂了。大家热情，是我的看法。
examples.py: zhè piān wén zhāng , wǒ dú dǒng le . dà jiā rè qíng , shì wǒ de kàn fa .
examples.en: I have read and understood this passage. “Everyone is welcoming” is my impression.

commonMistakes.why: In this basic verb-object phrase the action 参加 precedes its object 活动.

grammar.pattern: 可能 / 可以 / 会 + action
grammar.purpose: Separate possibility, permission and predicted events
grammar.explanation: 可能 expresses uncertainty: 明天可能下雨. 可以 can grant permission or indicate feasibility: 可以参加. 会 can predict an event: 明天会下雨, as well as learned ability from earlier lessons. A prediction is not proof; use 可能 when uncertain. Put the modal before the main action and use 不可能/不可以/不会 for the relevant negative meaning.

examples.zh: 我可以参加吗？可以，明天可能还有新同学。
examples.py: wǒ kě yǐ cān jiā ma ? kě yǐ , míng tiān kě néng hái yǒu xīn tóng xué .
examples.en: May I join? Yes; there may be more new classmates tomorrow.

commonMistakes.why: Do not combine a certainty claim with uncertain 可能 for the same prediction.

grammar.purpose: Give advice without turning it into a command
grammar.explanation: 该 and 应该 introduce what one should do: 我该带什么 / 应该先问. They do not guarantee an action has happened. 不该/不应该 negate the advised action. A question 我该… asks for guidance; 该不该… asks whether an action is advisable. Advice about a host’s needs still requires information from that host.

examples.zh: 我该带什么？你应该先问主人。
examples.py: wǒ gāi dài shén me ? nǐ yīng gāi xiān wèn zhǔ ren .
examples.en: What should I bring? You should ask the host first.

examples.zh: 我该不该带食物？主人说不用带。
examples.py: wǒ gāi bù gāi dài shí wù ? zhǔ ren shuō bù yòng dài .
examples.en: Should I bring food? The host said there was no need.

examples.zh: 不应该随便猜，先问清楚。
examples.py: bù yīng gāi suí biàn cāi , xiān wèn qīng chǔ .
examples.en: We should not guess casually; ask clearly first.

commonMistakes.why: To give advice use 应该 + action; adding 了 would change the reading to an inference or completed event.

grammar.pattern: 好吗 / 可以吗 / 行吗 / 怎么样
grammar.purpose: Make a proposal and check permission
grammar.explanation: 好吗 checks whether a proposal is acceptable: 六点半，好吗. 可以吗 and 行吗 commonly ask permission or feasibility: 我带水，可以吗. 怎么样 asks for an evaluation of a proposed option: 带书怎么样. These are not guarantees of agreement; the reply may accept, refuse or suggest another option. Use a real option before the question ending.

examples.py: liù diǎn bàn lái , hǎo ma ? hǎo .
examples.en: Come at half past six, okay? Okay.

examples.zh: 我带两瓶水，可以吗？行吗？可以。
examples.py: wǒ dài liǎng píng shuǐ , kě yǐ ma ? xíng ma ? kě yǐ .
examples.en: May I bring two bottles of water? Is that okay? Yes.

examples.zh: 带这本书怎么样？合适，她喜欢读书。
examples.py: dài zhè běn shū zěn me yàng ? hé shì , tā xǐ huān dú shū .
examples.en: How about bringing this book? Suitable; she likes reading.

commonMistakes.why: 好吗 evaluates an actual proposal; 带什么 asks for the missing choice.

grammar.purpose: State willingness separately from availability
grammar.explanation: 愿意 expresses willingness or preference, not just learned ability or permission. 我愿意帮忙，可是今晚不方便 separates being willing from being free. 不愿意 can sound like a direct refusal; give an honest reason or alternative when appropriate. 愿意不愿意 asks about willingness, while 方便吗 asks about availability.

examples.zh: 我愿意参加，可是今天有事。
examples.py: wǒ yuàn yì cān jiā , kě shì jīn tiān yǒu shì .
examples.en: I am willing to join, but I have something on today.

examples.zh: 你愿意不愿意星期六来？愿意，但时间还要商量。
examples.py: nǐ yuàn yì bù yuàn yì xīng qī liù lái ? yuàn yì , dàn shí jiān hái yào shāng liang .
examples.en: Are you willing to come on Saturday? Yes, but we still need to discuss the time.

commonMistakes.why: State the action after 愿意; 星期六 alone is a time, not the willing action.

grammar.purpose: Suggest the preferred alternative
grammar.explanation: 还是…吧 proposes a preferable option after considering alternatives: 太晚了，还是星期六见吧. This is different from a choice question 星期五还是星期六. The proposal is not accepted until the other person agrees. A gentler refusal can acknowledge the invitation, state the difficulty and propose another time.

examples.zh: 今晚太晚了，还是星期六见吧。
examples.py: jīn wǎn tài wǎn le , hái shi xīng qī liù jiàn ba .
examples.en: Tonight is too late; let us meet on Saturday instead.

examples.zh: 你星期五还是星期六方便？星期六。还是星期六吧。
examples.py: nǐ xīng qī wǔ hái shi xīng qī liù fāng biàn ? xīng qī liù . hái shi xīng qī liù ba .
examples.en: Is Friday or Saturday convenient? Saturday. Let us choose Saturday, then.

commonMistakes.wrong: 今晚还是星期六见吧吗？
commonMistakes.right: 今晚不方便，还是星期六见吧。
commonMistakes.why: Do not append 吗 to the 吧 suggestion; explain why Saturday is preferable.

lines.en: My friend felt a little sad but believed I was not unwilling. She said she was on leave on Saturday, so it might be convenient.

lines.zh: 假期的计划还没定，我也不一定知道几点方便。我们先商量，听对方的意见。
lines.py: jià qī de jì huà hái méi dìng , wǒ yě bù yí dìng zhī dào jǐ diǎn fāng biàn . wǒ men xiān shāng liang , tīng duì fāng de yì jian .
lines.en: Holiday plans are not settled, and I do not necessarily know what time is convenient. We will discuss it and hear each other’s opinions.

lines.zh: 我打算先休息，心情好一点再见朋友。她改变了原来的计划。

lines.en: I plan to rest first and meet friends when I feel better. She changed the original plan.

lines.zh: 她让我放心：今晚不来，没有关系；明天告诉她，再改时间。
lines.py: tā ràng wǒ fàng xīn : jīn wǎn bù lái , méi yǒu guān xì ; míng tiān gào sù tā , zài gǎi shí jiān .
lines.en: She reassured me: not coming tonight is okay; tell her tomorrow, then change the time.

lines.zh: 我没有说一定星期六六点见。我们答应明天再定，不能把一个想法当成最后的计划。
lines.py: wǒ méi yǒu shuō yí dìng xīng qī liù liù diǎn jiàn . wǒ men dā ying míng tiān zài dìng , bù néng bǎ yī gè xiǎng fa dàng chéng zuì hòu de jì huà .

grammar.pattern: 多久 / 为什么 / 怎么样 / 怎样
grammar.purpose: Ask for duration, reason or manner
grammar.explanation: 多久 asks duration, not a clock time: 坐车要多久 versus 几点出发. 为什么 asks a reason. 怎么样 often asks an evaluation or condition: 味道怎么样. 怎样 can ask the manner of doing something: 怎样去, and can also ask an evaluation. Put the question word where the missing information belongs; these questions do not need 吗. A reason may use 因为, taught more fully later; a simple 因为 clause is a useful recognition answer here.

examples.zh: 坐车要多久？二十分钟。几点出发？六点。
examples.py: zuò chē yào duō jiǔ ? èr shí fēn zhōng . jǐ diǎn chū fā ? liù diǎn .
examples.en: How long by vehicle? Twenty minutes. What time do we leave? Six.

examples.zh: 为什么选这里？这里安静。味道怎么样？不错。
examples.py: wèi shén me xuǎn zhè lǐ ? zhè lǐ ān jìng . wèi dao zěn me yàng ? bù cuò .
examples.en: Why choose here? It is quiet. How does it taste? Good.

examples.zh: 怎样去？坐车到大学站，再走五分钟。
examples.py: zěn yàng qù ? zuò chē dào dà xué zhàn , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng .
examples.en: How do we get there? Ride to University Station, then walk five minutes.

commonMistakes.why: Do not add 吗 to this question-word duration question.

grammar.pattern: 什么时候 / 什么样 / 为什么 / 怎么样 / 怎样
grammar.purpose: Choose the information a question requests
grammar.explanation: 什么时候 asks when; 什么样 asks kind or characteristics; 为什么 asks why; 怎么样/怎样 ask a condition, evaluation or way. Use context to disambiguate 怎样. 什么样的饭馆 is a kind question, not a request for the restaurant name. A preference answer is one person’s view and does not establish a universal quality ranking.

examples.zh: 什么时候去？今晚。想去什么样的饭馆？安静一点的。
examples.py: shén me shí hou qù ? jīn wǎn . xiǎng qù shén me yàng de fàn guǎn ? ān jìng yī diǎn de .

examples.zh: 为什么不叫外卖？想出去走走。这里服务怎么样？很热情。
examples.py: wèi shén me bù jiào wài mài ? xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu . zhè lǐ fú wù zěn me yàng ? hěn rè qíng .
examples.en: Why not order delivery? I want a walk. How is the service here? Welcoming.

examples.zh: 你认为怎样去合适？坐车吧。
examples.py: nǐ rèn wéi zěn yàng qù hé shì ? zuò chē ba .
examples.en: What way of getting there do you think is suitable? Let us take a vehicle.

commonMistakes.why: 什么时候 asks a time; 什么样 asks a kind or characteristic.

lines.zh: 午餐我吃快餐，昨天吃方便面。今晚不想叫外卖，想和朋友出去聊天。
lines.py: wǔ cān wǒ chī kuài cān , zuó tiān chī fāng biàn miàn . jīn wǎn bù xiǎng jiào wài mài , xiǎng hé péng you chū qù liáo tiān .
lines.en: I had fast food for lunch and instant noodles yesterday. Tonight I do not want delivery; I want to go out and chat with a friend.

lines.zh: 我问想去什么样的饭馆，朋友说安静一点的，碗和桌子也应该干净。
lines.py: wǒ wèn xiǎng qù shén me yàng de fàn guǎn , péng you shuō ān jìng yī diǎn de , wǎn hé zhuō zi yě yīng gāi gān jìng .
lines.en: I asked what kind of restaurant; my friend said a somewhat quieter one with clean bowls and tables.

lines.zh: 我们认为这家合适。选择它的原因是方便聊天，服务顾客也很热情。
lines.py: wǒ men rèn wéi zhè jiā hé shì . xuǎn zé tā de yuán yīn shì fāng biàn liáo tiān , fú wù gù kè yě hěn rè qíng .
lines.en: We think this place is suitable. We choose it because it is convenient for chatting, and it serves customers warmly.

lines.zh: 我们的看法不完全一样，口味也不同。比如我不想吃辣的鸡蛋，她想吃别的菜。
lines.py: wǒ men de kàn fa bù wán quán yī yàng , kǒu wèi yě bù tóng . bǐ rú wǒ bù xiǎng chī là de jī dàn , tā xiǎng chī bié de cài .
lines.en: Our views are not entirely the same, and our tastes differ. For example, I do not want spicy eggs, while she wants another dish.

lines.zh: 这家的味道不错，我对菜很满意。好处是离家近，坏处是顾客多，要等二十分钟。
lines.py: zhè jiā de wèi dao bù cuò , wǒ duì cài hěn mǎn yì . hǎo chù shì lí jiā jìn , huài chù shì gù kè duō , yào děng èr shí fēn zhōng .
lines.en: The food tastes good and I am satisfied with it. It is close to home, but the drawback is many customers and a twenty-minute wait.

lines.zh: 等了很久，我有点不满，但没有说菜不好吃。评价要讲清楚是哪一件事。
lines.py: děng le hěn jiǔ , wǒ yǒu diǎn bù mǎn , dàn méi yǒu shuō cài bù hǎo chī . píng jià yào jiǎng qīng chǔ shì nǎ yī jiàn shì .
lines.en: I am a little dissatisfied with waiting a long time, but did not say the food was bad. An evaluation should specify which aspect.

lines.zh: 怎样去？坐车十分钟，再走五分钟。什么时候出发？我们定六点。
lines.py: zěn yàng qù ? zuò chē shí fēn zhōng , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng . shén me shí hou chū fā ? wǒ men dìng liù diǎn .
lines.en: How do we get there? Ride ten minutes, then walk five. When do we leave? We decided on six.

lines.zh: 要多久可以坐下，还要问店里。路上十五分钟，不是已经有了座位。
lines.py: yào duō jiǔ kě yǐ zuò xià , hái yào wèn diàn lǐ . lù shàng shí wǔ fēn zhōng , bù shì yǐ jīng yǒu le zuò wèi .
lines.en: We still need to ask the restaurant how long until we can sit. Fifteen minutes of travel does not mean a seat is already available.

grammar.purpose: Describe a brief try, not a long repeated routine
grammar.explanation: Reduplication often makes an action brief or tentative: 看看 (AA), 看一看 (A一A), 看了看 (A了A, a brief past action), 练习练习 (ABAB). Do not reduplicate every verb or use this pattern to promise a long duration. A了A places 了 between the copies, not at the end as 看看了. Compare a short 练一练 with listening to a whole passage twice: 听两遍.

commonMistakes.why: For the A了A pattern, put 了 between the repeated verb copies.

grammar.pattern: 遍 / 次 / 场 / 回 / 下
grammar.purpose: Match the counter to what is being counted
grammar.explanation: 遍 counts a whole pass: 听两遍. 次 counts occurrences without saying each was complete: 检查两次. 场 counts events such as a film showing: 一场电影. 回 is an informal occurrence counter: 去过一回. 下 can count a short movement, as 拍三下, or soften a brief action in 看一下. The noun/action determines the counter; one is not a substitute for every other.

examples.zh: 听两遍录音，不是只听了两次开头。
examples.py: tīng liǎng biàn lù yīn , bù shì zhǐ tīng le liǎng cì kāi tóu .
examples.en: Listen to the recording twice through, not merely to its opening twice.

examples.zh: 看一场电影，去一回活动，检查两次答案。

examples.en: The teacher claps three times, then everyone looks briefly at the questions.

commonMistakes.why: A complete pass through a recording uses 遍; 场 counts an event such as a film showing.

grammar.purpose: Say how often an action happened
grammar.explanation: A verb can take an action-count complement: 听了两遍, 检查了三次. With an object, common patterns include 听了两遍录音 and 录音听了两遍. A count states the number, not whether the learner understood. For a person/pronoun object placement can differ; start with the complete passage and checking contexts here. 次 does not mean minutes.

grammar.pattern: 这么 / 那么 / 这样 / 那样
grammar.purpose: Separate degree from manner
grammar.explanation: 这么/那么 often indicate degree before adjectives: 这么小、那么冷. 这样/那样 often indicate manner: 这样做、那样猜. 这 points to the current or nearer context; 那 to a previously mentioned or more distant context. They are not automatically two different times. Compare 图片这么小 (degree) with 这样看日期 (method).

examples.zh: 图片这么小，日期看不清楚。
examples.py: tú piàn zhè me xiǎo , rì qī kàn bù qīng chu .
examples.en: The picture is so small that the date is unclear.

examples.zh: 昨天没那么冷，今天冷多了。
examples.py: zuó tiān méi nà me lěng , jīn tiān lěng duō le .
examples.en: Yesterday was not that cold; today is much colder.

examples.zh: 我们这样做，别像昨天那样猜。
examples.py: wǒ men zhè yàng zuò , bié xiàng zuó tiān nà yàng cāi .
examples.en: Let us do it this way, rather than guess like yesterday.

commonMistakes.why: For degree before 小, use 这么; 这样 is used here for the way an action is done.

grammar.purpose: Recover an omitted noun and follow an action sequence
grammar.explanation: A modifier + 的 can stand for a contextually known noun: 新的 means the new one when discussing notices; 朋友写的 means the one written by a friend. Do not assume a noun without context. A serial phrase describes one subject’s actions without a linking conjunction: 去问主办方、发短信告诉你. The later action can express purpose; order alone does not prove both actions are complete.

grammar.purpose: Use natural adjective reduplication in context
grammar.explanation: Some adjectives repeat as AA or AABB to make a description vivid: 红红的、干干净净. The reduplicated form usually does not take 很 directly before it: 干干净净, not 很干干净净. This is not a rule that every adjective can be repeated. Use 清清楚楚 and 开开心心 for manner/state when appropriate; the meaning is not a numerical comparison.

examples.zh: 红红的围巾，是朋友送的。
examples.py: hóng hóng de wéi jīn , shì péng you sòng de .
examples.en: The red scarf was a gift from a friend.

examples.zh: 白色的衣服洗得干干净净。
examples.py: bái sè de yī fú xǐ dé gān gān jìng jìng .
examples.en: The white clothes have been washed nice and clean.

examples.zh: 我们开开心心地去见朋友。
examples.py: wǒ men kāi kāi xīn xīn de qù jiàn péng you .
examples.en: We go happily to meet our friends.

commonMistakes.why: The vivid AABB form does not normally follow 很 here.

grammar.purpose: Describe a property or a comparison precisely
grammar.explanation: An adjective phrase can include degree or negation: 有点凉、不太重、很合适. It can describe a noun with 的 or act as a predicate without 是: 不太重的衣服; 这件衣服不太重. 很 often gives a neutral predicate rather than extreme intensity. In 价格不低, the property is price, not physical height or the owner’s status.

examples.zh: 晚上有点凉，带不太重的衣服。
examples.py: wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , dài bù tài zhòng de yī fú .
examples.en: It is a little cool at night; bring clothes that are not too heavy.

examples.zh: 这双鞋很合适，价格不低。
examples.py: zhè shuāng xié hěn hé shì , jià gé bù dī .
examples.en: These shoes fit well and are not cheap.

examples.py: lǜ sè de nà jiàn bǐ jiào qīng .
examples.en: That green one is relatively light.

commonMistakes.why: Use the adjective phrase directly as the neutral predicate; 是 would require an emphasis context.

grammar.purpose: Combine two compatible descriptions
grammar.explanation: 又…又… joins qualities that hold of the same referent: 又轻又短、又普通又舒服. It does not mean one quality belongs to one person and the other to someone else. Both may be positive or negative; the conjunction itself is not praise. Do not force contradictory qualities in the same sense without explaining different parts or circumstances.

examples.zh: 这双鞋又重又贵，我今天不穿。

commonMistakes.why: After each 又 use a compatible predicate, not a bare colour noun such as 蓝色.

grammar.purpose: Read large units rather than substituting English groups
grammar.explanation: 千 = 1,000; 万 = 10,000; 亿 = 100,000,000. Chinese large-number grouping uses 万 and 亿. 一万 is ten thousands; 一亿 is ten thousand 万. 二万 and 两万 can occur, while 两千 is common; do not turn 两万 into two thousand. Use explicit digits when checking a financial label. The large numbers here are reading practice, not this outing’s actual budget.

examples.en: One thousand is ten hundreds; ten thousand is ten thousands.

examples.en: One hundred million is ten thousand ten-thousands, not one million.

commonMistakes.why: 万 denotes ten thousand; 千 denotes one thousand.

grammar.pattern: number + 多 + classifier / number + classifier + 多
grammar.purpose: Keep approximate counts and fractional extras separate
grammar.explanation: 十多个人 gives an integer count over ten, commonly in the teens. 一百多块 gives more than one hundred yuan without an exact total. 一个多小时 is more than one hour, normally less than two; 多 follows the duration classifier. 三斤多 is a little over three jin. These are approximate descriptions, not exact sums; the actual amount may need confirmation. Do not interpret 十多个人 as 10.5 people or 一个多小时 as more than ten hours.

lines.zh: 先数人数吧。
lines.py: xiān shǔ rén shù ba .
lines.en: Let us count the people first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 三个人，全到了。要买的东西不少，我先算一算。
lines.py: sān gè rén , quán dào le . yào mǎi de dōng xi bù shǎo , wǒ xiān suàn yī suàn .
lines.en: Three people, all here. There are quite a few things to buy; I will calculate first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 车票一部分，饭和水果一部分，一共多少？
lines.py: chē piào yī bù fèn , fàn hé shuǐ guǒ yī bù fèn , yī gòng duō shao ?
lines.en: Tickets are one part and food and fruit another; what is the total?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 全部一百二十块。分成三份，每人四十。
lines.py: quán bù yī bǎi èr shí kuài . fēn chéng sān fèn , měi rén sì shí .
lines.en: One hundred and twenty altogether. Three shares of forty.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我收入不多，这次预算一百五十，够吗？
lines.py: wǒ shōu rù bù duō , zhè cì yù suàn yī bǎi wǔ shí , gòu ma ?
lines.en: My income is not large; I budgeted one hundred and fifty for this outing. Is that enough?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 够。正好付一百二十，还剩三十。
lines.py: gòu . zhèng hǎo fù yī bǎi èr shí , hái shèng sān shí .
lines.en: Yes. Pay exactly one hundred and twenty; thirty remains.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这家店卖水果。买一公斤，两斤，对吗？
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn mài shuǐ guǒ . mǎi yī gōng jīn , liǎng jīn , duì ma ?
lines.en: This shop sells fruit. One kilogram is two jin, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。五角是半块，别把角和块看成一样。
lines.py: duì . wǔ jiǎo shì bàn kuài , bié bǎ jiǎo hé kuài kàn chéng yī yàng .
lines.en: Yes. Five jiao is half a yuan; do not treat jiao and yuan as the same.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这张银行卡能用吗？我也带了现金。
lines.py: zhè zhāng yín háng kǎ néng yòng ma ? wǒ yě dài le xiàn jīn .
lines.en: Can I use this bank card? I also brought cash.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先问店里。今天每人花四十，不是四十万。
lines.py: xiān wèn diàn lǐ . jīn tiān měi rén huā sì shí , bù shì sì shí wàn .
lines.en: Ask the shop first. Today each person spends forty, not four hundred thousand.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 哈哈。一千、一万、一亿，只是在练数字吧？
lines.py: hā hā . yī qiān , yī wàn , yī yì , zhǐ shì zài liàn shù zì ba ?
lines.en: Ha. One thousand, ten thousand and a hundred million are just number practice, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。十多个人和一个多小时也要分清，不能当今天的准确人数和时间。
lines.py: duì . shí duō gè rén hé yī gè duō xiǎo shí yě yào fēn qīng , bù néng dāng jīn tiān de zhǔn què rén shù hé shí jiān .
lines.en: Right. Distinguish more than ten people from over an hour too; neither is today’s exact count or time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.en: Tickets are one portion, food and fruit another; the total is one hundred and twenty yuan.

lines.py: wǒ dài le yín háng kǎ hé xiàn jīn , kǎ néng bù néng yòng , hái yào wèn diàn lǐ .
lines.en: I brought a bank card and cash; I still need to ask whether the shop accepts the card.

lines.zh: 数一数，三个人。算一算，一百二十。
lines.py: shǔ yī shǔ , sān gè rén . suàn yī suàn , yī bǎi èr shí .
lines.en: Count: three people. Calculate: one hundred and twenty.

lines.zh: 分三份，正好四十。花四十，别把万写上。
lines.py: fēn sān fèn , zhèng hǎo sì shí . huā sì shí , bié bǎ wàn xiě shàng .
lines.en: Three shares, exactly forty. Spend forty; do not add ten-thousands.

lines.zh: 五角半块，两斤一公斤。店里卖水果，单位看清。
lines.py: wǔ jiǎo bàn kuài , liǎng jīn yī gōng jīn . diàn lǐ mài shuǐ guǒ , dān wèi kàn qīng .
lines.en: Five jiao, half a yuan; two jin, a kilogram. The shop sells fruit; read the units clearly.

lines.zh: 千、万、亿，数字来练。一万不是一千，今天不用花一万。
lines.py: qiān , wàn , yì , shù zì lái liàn . yī wàn bù shì yī qiān , jīn tiān bù yòng huā yī wàn .
lines.en: Thousand, ten-thousand, hundred-million: practise numbers. Ten thousand is not a thousand; no need to spend ten thousand today.

lines.zh: 十多个人，一个多小时。一个是人数，一个是时间。
lines.py: shí duō gè rén , yī gè duō xiǎo shí . yī gè shì rén shù , yī gè shì shí jiān .
lines.en: More than ten people, a little over an hour. One counts people; one measures time.

lines.zh: 卡先问，现金带上。收入和预算，不用猜别人的。
lines.py: kǎ xiān wèn , xiàn jīn dài shàng . shōu rù hé yù suàn , bù yòng cāi bié ren de .
lines.en: Ask about the card; bring cash. No need to guess another person’s income or budget.
